thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — 2119876543 — model-quality-regression: text-embedder-v3 (eu-west1)

oncall-bot: Symptoms: similarity scores drop >15% vs baseline for top-5, error rate for embedding requests increased from ~2.3% -> ~12.8%. Severity: P2 (customer-facing degradation in EU). Pager triggered to @Emma Li, @Miguel Santos, @Priya Patel.

Emma Li: I'm on it. Can someone confirm recent deploys in eu-west1 in the last 2 hours?

Miguel Santos: Deployed quantized build 2026-02-13-rc4 at 03:04 UTC to canary. Benchmarks looked okay earlier but we started seeing odd similarity metrics ~03:10.

Jake Chen: I pulled traces — requests with seq_len < 128 show higher cosine variance. Looks like quantization changed the scale factor for some kernels (A100).

Priya Patel: Ok mitigation plan proposal: 1) split traffic to stable v2, 2) enable shadow routing to collect failing inputs, 3) prepare rollback & customer comms.

Nina (CSE): I'll draft a short customer notification for EU customers (esp. high-volume embed users).

Emma Li: Oncall -> Miguel/Jake run a quick AB split 90/10 (v3/v2) in eu-west1 to confirm model-specific regression. Priya, prep rollback steps if AB confirms.

Miguel Santos: Running AB test now. Command I'm using: 
``
rcctl traffic-split --model text-embedder-v3 --region eu-west1 --split 90,10 --alt-model text-embedder-v2-20260210
``

ops-bot: AB test applied. 10% -> text-embedder-v2-20260210. Metrics job started: embedding-similarity-eu-backfill.

Jake Chen: Early AB results: top-5 precision v3=0.62 vs v2=0.78 (baseline 0.79). That's pretty conclusive.

Emma Li: Confirming we should rollback. Priya, execute rollback and pin stable version in eu-west1. Use staged rollout to avoid request spikes.

Priya Patel: Rollback sequence queued, executing now. Command: 
``
reconcile-model --action promote --model text-embedder-v2-20260210 --region eu-west1 --pin
```

deploy-bot: Promote job started. Estimated ~7m to complete. Canary kept for monitoring.

Emma Li: Draft status page update below — please suggest edits: 
``
Status: Partial degradation (embeddings) in eu-west1
Impact: Some customers may see lower-quality embedding similarity scores or increased error rates for embedding requests routed to text-embedder-v3.
Current status: Mitigation in progress — routing a portion of traffic to the stable embedder and promoting stable version to eu-west1. No data loss.
Next update: in 30 minutes or on successful rollback.
```

Nina (CSE): Customer email draft (short): 
``
Subject: [Redwood] Brief service notice: embeddings in eu-west1
Hi — we detected a regression affecting embedding similarity quality for requests routed to our eu-west1 model. We're rolling back to a stable build (text-embedder-v2) and expect resolution within 15–30 minutes. No action required on your side. Reach out to support@redwood.ai if you see persistent issues.

Thanks — Redwood Support
```

Emma Li: Internal summary for product/sales: 
``
Summary: Canary deploy of quantized embedder (v3 rc4) in eu-west1 caused degradation in similarity metrics. Rollback to v2 successful. Impact window ~03:04–03:22 UTC. Root cause: quantization scale mismatch in kernel selection on A100 drivers in eu-west1. Follow-ups: additional regression tests for quantized kernels, tighten canary thresholds for embedding quality, automatic AB-split alerts.
```

Priya Patel: Rollback completed; deploy-bot reports success. Monitoring shows error rate and precision back near baseline.

ops-bot: Rollback verification complete. embedding-similarity-eu-backfill job PASS. Error rate now ~1.9% (pre-incident ~2.3%).

Emma Li: Sending status page update and customer emails now. Creating postmortem doc and assigning follow-ups.

Nina (CSE): Customer comms sent to EU high-volume list. I'll do one-on-one outreach to top enterprise customers.

Emma Li: Follow-ups assigned:
- Miguel: investigate quantization mismatch and produce test matrix (owner: Miguel)
- Jake: add e2e embedding quality test in CI against quantized kernels (owner: Jake)
- Priya: adjust canary thresholds + autorollback on metric regressions (owner: Priya)

Emma Li: If no objections, I'll mark incident mitigated in 15m and start the postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident 2119876543 state -> MITIGATED at 2119879977

Emma Li: Marked mitigated and starting postmortem doc: https://weblink/reports/2119876543 (draft)

Nina (CSE): Adding customer follow-up notes to the postmortem doc.

end.
